strings.name: Andy Jassy
strings.summary: Andy Jassy helped establish and long led Amazon Web Services, developing computing and storage infrastructure into services customers could use on demand. He succeeded Jeff Bezos as Amazon's chief executive in 2021, overseeing retail, logistics and cloud businesses. His tenure has included AI infrastructure investment, post-pandemic cost adjustments and large layoffs, illustrating the tension between platform expansion and operating discipline.
